profile.name: Uttara Iyer
profile.writeup:
Uttara Iyer is an Emirati cricketer who plays as a right-handed middle-order batter and utility contributor for the United Arab Emirates women’s national team. Rising through the UAE’s rapidly expanding grassroots and age-group development system, she is regarded as one of the promising young batting talents entering the senior international fold.


Iyer initially made her mark in the UAE age-group setup, representing the United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 side in regional junior competitions and bilateral developmental series. Her composure in the middle order, ability to rotate strike, and sharp fielding earned her promotion to the senior national pool. She broke into the United Arab Emirates Women’s senior squad for regional international assignments, including multi-nation ICC and ACC pathway fixtures, positioning her among the next generation of players aiming to establish themselves in the UAE's senior core.


In the UAE domestic circuit, Iyer has honed her game through local academies, school cricket, and Emirates Cricket Board-sanctioned domestic tournaments. Featuring in domestic white-ball competitions and representative XI fixtures, she has primarily operated as a stabilizing middle-order presence, noted for her adaptability between anchoring an innings and accelerating under match pressure.
